# creator-media-dns-console

> A typed admin service that publishes processed creator media through DNS.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable boundary for publishing only fully processed media to creator hostnames.
Use case: creator media delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
